title: Rustom
desc: Rustom, a naval officer, shares a happy relationship with his wife Cynthia. Soon, he discovers her affair with Vikram, a close friend, and is accused of murdering him.

title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest of three siblings, refuses to get married to maintain harmony in his family. However, complications arise after his brothers conspire for him to fall in love.

title: Laadla
desc: Raju, an upright union leader, can do anything at his wheelchair-bound mother's behest, even if it means breaking his own heart and giving in to a rude heiress.

title: Arya Ek Deewana
desc: After getting separated and growing up differently, two orphan childhood friends reunite and later fall into trouble when they fall in love with the same woman.

title: Baadshah
desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

title: Heropanti 2
desc: A vigilante is sent on a mission by the government to kill enemy troops. However, things go wrong when he's mistaken for the leader of the troops.

title: Welcome 2 Karachi
desc: Amid high political tensions, two Indian men accidentally arrive in Pakistan without their passports and are kidnapped by the Taliban. Hilarious chaos ensues as they try to make their way back home.

title: Mega Crocodile
desc: A researcher is commissioned to search for a missing person on the Hell Island full of crocodiles but soon find themselves endangered when giant crocodiles begin threatening their lives.

title: Genius
desc: An orphan with a genius mind hatches a plan to avenge the killing of his colleagues in order to live in peace with the one he loves.

title: Bangarraju
desc: A deceased couple returns to Earth to help their grandson, who lost his way in life after familial and personal problems start to haunt him.

title: The Hero: Love Story of a Spy
desc: Arun Khanna, an Indian spy, collaborates with Reshma to stop a nuclear attack. However, Reshma's identity is compromised during her undercover mission in Pakistan.

title: Makkhi
desc: After reincarnating as a fly, a murderer decides to take revenge on his rival, who killed him, and teams up with a woman to destroy the killer's life.

title: Dil Madharaasi
desc: Heartbroken by a recent split, a troubled individual joins a mission to halt an illegal arms distribution syndicate. Subsequently, he struggles with his painful history to prevent catastrophe.

title: Bimbisara
desc: Getting betrayed by his brother, ancient evil king Bimbisara teleports to the modern-day world and gets trapped in the mirror.
